talent_sourcing_thesis: Target engineers associated with the Uncore PMU task group, system architecture teams, and contributors to the standard MMIO performance specification framework.

Actively source kernel developers and performance engineers who designed, built, or maintained the 'arm_cspmu' (CoreSight System PMU) driver infrastructure to transition their experience directly to open RISC-V equivalents.

Source hardware-software co-design engineers deeply experienced with the proprietary NVIDIA SCF PMU layer who understand how custom interconnect fabrics interact with enterprise AI and GPU compute workloads.
